personality_one_liner: A cinematic, high-end logistics experience anchored in charcoal slate and antique gold, emphasizing clarity, premium service, and effortless booking.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use md/lg for internal card padding, xl for section breathing room. Layouts should feel cinematic, not cramped.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar over map/content
Use translucent tinted base (≥75% of surface) underneath glass to ensure readability
Apply frosted glass overlay to featured vehicle hero card
Use glass for sticky header backgrounds and modal scrims
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields
Do not rely solely on blur without a tinted background layer

screens.name: Welcome & Auth
screens.purpose: A premium cinematic entry using a dark map or abstract gold texture backdrop.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse equivalent). Display app name in Fraunces. Phone OTP input in a sleek surfaceSecondary card at the bottom. Primary CTA sticky at bottom.

screens.name: Home (Live Map)
screens.purpose: Map-first discovery and quick booking entry.

states.error: Error message if location permissions fail.

screens.layout: Full-screen dark mode map. Bottom sheet (glass or surfaceSecondary) housing 'Where to?' input, quick chips (Home, Work), and 'Add Stop' button for multiple drops.

screens.name: Vehicle Selection
screens.purpose: Present the selected vehicle hero card and a sleek list of alternatives.

states.loading: Skeleton of hero card and list items.
states.empty: Illustration + 'No vehicles available in your area'.

screens.layout: Top half: Prominent large glass card showing the currently selected vehicle, name, weight capacity (e.g. 750kg), arrival time, and Total Fare (Hide per-km breakdown). Bottom half: Scrollable vertical list of other vehicles (Two-wheeler to 17ft) with small Phosphor icons and fares.

screens.name: Booking Summary & Payment
screens.purpose: Review route and total fare, select payment method.
screens.layout: Sleek surfaceSecondary cards for route details. Large prominent total fare at bottom. Payment options (COD Pickup/Drop/UPI) in selectable rows with brandPrimary active states. Confirm CTA pinned at bottom.

screens.name: Live Tracking
screens.purpose: Track driver en route in a premium dark map environment.
screens.layout: Full-screen map. Floating glass pill for ETA at top. Bottom sheet featuring driver profile, vehicle details, and contact buttons.

screens.name: Account Profile
screens.layout: Clean vertical list for Saved Addresses, GST Details, Refer & Earn, Help & Support, Terms, Logout. Use surfaceSecondary for list rows with subtle divider.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '6 Glass / Luxe' personality. The app must feel cinematic and high-end, utilizing a strict charcoal/gold color scheme.
Implement the Vehicle Selection screen precisely as requested: a large, prominent featured card at the top for the selected vehicle, and a sleek vertical list beneath it for other alternatives.
IMPORTANT: Only display the TOTAL fare on pricing screens. Strictly hide any per-km rate breakdown, aligning with the premium experience guidelines.
Ensure the Multi-Stop Address Entry is fluid, with a clear 'Add Stop' interaction for multiple drop-offs.
Use Phosphor icons consistently across all tabs and lists. Account tab list must precisely match the provided items (Saved Addresses, GST Details, Refer & Earn, Help & Support, Terms, Logout).
Enforce proper contrast on glassmorphic elements—use translucent tinted base behind blur effects on bottom sheets and cards.
